110180101.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's been a long time.

110180102.text: Oh, hey, Huixin! Long time no see!

110180103.text: Fancy meeting you here. How's work these days?

110180104.text: Thanks to the help of people like you and colleagues like Ganyu, better all the time.

110180105.text: But I've been feeling distracted at work lately. I just feel constantly agitated...

110180107.text: *sigh* It's a long story, but my father... He's thinking of stepping down from the Tianshu position due to health issues.

110180108.text: Huh? What's wrong with Uncle Tian?

110180109.text: Nothing, specifically... He's not unwell, he says he's just increasingly low on energy these days.

110180110.text: He's always said, "Old age comes for us all in the end"... Still, I just can't help but feel a little emotional watching it happen to him.

110180111.text: Anyway, my father's currently on the second floor of Yanshang Teahouse. Why don't you come pay him a visit with me?

110180112.text: He seems very fond of you two. I'm sure chatting with you will make him very happy.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the 2nd floor of Yanshang Teahouse

110180301.text: Uncle Tian! We're here to chat with you!

110180302.text: Oh? Hah, what a lovely surprise. Welcome. Huixin, why don't you go downstairs and get the shopkeeper to make us a fresh pot of tea?

110180303.text: I heard that you've been traveling all over the place recently. I would very much like to hear your adventure stories.

110180306.text: Huixin told you, didn't she... Don't worry, I'm quite alright. It's just the years gradually catching up with me.

110180307.text: As I grow older, I'm starting to find that with many things, though the mind is willing, the flesh is weak. Especially recently, I've noticed a rather drastic drop in my energy levels.

110180308.text: I am still very much in good standing as the Tianshu today. Nevertheless, I wish to pass on the position before my mental acuity begins to decline beyond redemption.

110180309.text: How difficult is it to transfer the Tianshu position?

110180310.text: Oh, well, you see, the Tianshu is a rather unique position among the Liyue Qixing.

110180311.text: Historically speaking, the Tianshu rarely appears in public. We stay behind the scenes, planning and giving advice. So a public selection process would not be suitable.

110180312.text: We also want to keep any prospective Tianshu candidates free from influence by outside forces, so we tend to be as discreet as possible in their assessment and appointment.

110180313.text: For these reasons, the incumbent Tianshu typically recommends their candidate of choice, and this is then approved by the other Qixing members.

110180314.text: So in other words, you pick someone, and then Lady Keqing, Lady Ningguang, and the other Qixing appoint them?

110180315.text: Correct. Unfortunately, due to my health, I won't be able to assess every candidate myself.

110180316.text: Not to despair, however, because I've found someone exceptionally capable to act on my behalf as assessment officer. In fact, I believe you recently became acquainted with her yourself.

110180318.text: I'm heartbroken... I thought it might take you a little longer than this to forget all about me?

110180320.text: Jackpot. Uncle Tian here asked me to assess three candidates for him.

110180321.text: #Fancy joining me, {NICKNAME}? You'll be among the first to get to know the next Tianshu. Might be a good opportunity for you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Yuehai Pavilion to perform your inspection

110180401.text: My legs are getting sore... What is wrong with this assessment officer? This is a huge occasion, and I don't even get a chair.

110180402.text: I've dealt with all kinds of people in my time, but never have I been made to stand while I'm waiting for an appointment.

110180403.text: Oh, I mean... I—I think it's fine...

110180404.text: That's called being complacent. If you're happy to just accept the way things are, you'll never be able to change anything in the future.

110180405.text: Oh, come on, that's just... Now you're just... being unreasonable.

110180406.text: Alright, you two. Let's not get into a big argument over this. It's not worth it.

110180407.text: Qianwei, that was a bit uncalled for. And Mingbo, cut him some slack. We've all been standing around for a while. It's natural to be getting irritable.

110180408.text: Look, how about this: There's no rule saying we're obliged to stand up while we wait, so why don't we borrow some chairs from the guild nearby?

110180409.text: Fine. They're not the best quality chairs, to be sure, but under the circumstances, it would be better than nothing.

110180410.text: You enter the assessment venue with Yelan...

110180411.text: It looks like all three candidates have arrived.

110180413.text: Mm-hmm. We'll meet them formally soon. Before that, let me run you through the assessment process.

110180414.text: I've split it into two stages: "Current Affairs and Planning" and "Face-to-Face Interview."

110180415.text: In the first stage, candidates are required to submit a manifesto for Liyue's development. In the second stage, we will ask them some questions in person.

110180416.text: Writing a manifesto takes time, so I informed them of this requirement in advance. These are the reports they submitted.

110180417.text: Wow, one of them is really thick...

110180418.text: It's also worth mentioning a stipulation I gave them: Whoever is appointed as the new Tianshu will be expected to implement their plan as put forward in their manifesto.

110180419.text: Failing the occurrence of some cataclysmic event, they will not be permitted to change their plan. Therefore, these three piles of documents in front of us represent where each candidate stands on key policy issues.

110180420.text: There is still some time. Have a skim through, get a first impression of what each person's proposing.

110180421.text: I'll be waiting off to the side. Just let me know when you're done.

110180701.text: (Qianwei's manifesto addresses many commercial issues and provides some very penetrating analysis.)

110180702.text: (His view seems to be that "regulations and incentives are both indispensable.")

110180801.text: (Mingbo's manifesto covers domestic affairs quite comprehensively, focusing on people's livelihoods.)

110180802.text: (The core principle seems to be "The greater good means a world that works for everyone.")

110180901.text: (Zhiyi's manifesto covers domestic affairs, foreign affairs, and checks and balances, all in great detail.)

110180902.text: (The focus seems to be "problem-solving." It provides concise and clear solutions to various problems.)

110180903.text: (It's so thick that you only have time to skim through it roughly...)

subQuests.subQuestName: Check on the three people with Yelan

110181001.text: Finished, huh? What did you think?

110181003.text: Of course they did. They have the chance to be picked as the new Tianshu, so you can bet they're putting their best foot forward.

110181004.text: And keep in mind, whoever gets in has to execute their plan as-written. Nobody wants to have any regrets.

110181006.text: Hehe, that's for me to know and you to find out. We can talk more after the interviews.

110181007.text: We'll see the candidates now. Let's do one at a time — start with Qianwei.

110181010.text: Oh? So you two are the assessment officers, are you?

110181011.text: I had assumed that given the great import of this situation, Lady Ningguang would perhaps be assessing us in person. I certainly hadn't imagined I'd be seeing two entirely unfamiliar faces.

110181012.text: I trust you've read through my manifesto? I'd be more than happy to clarify any details you found difficult to grasp — it was written with an expert audience in mind, after all.

110181014.text: Relax, it wasn't intended as a personal slight against anyone in particular. I was simply stating a fact.

110181017.text: Cloud Retainer... you know this adeptus? Oh... Yes, I remember now. You must be the traveler that people are constantly talking about.

110181018.text: With your sterling reputation, you must have a respectable level of erudition. Perhaps you will be able to understand the concepts I have put forward... although I shouldn't get my hopes up.

110181019.text: After asking Qianwei some questions, Yelan tells him to fetch Mingbo.

110181022.text: I'm, uh, Mingbo... I work in the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

110181023.text: I've worked there for, um, 9 years... 5 months... and 3 days. In that time, I've handled... 2,347 cases.

110181024.text: I have 12 active cases at the moment... They should be concluded in, uh... 16 days?

110181025.text: My current work is related to urban planning and I am also responsible for, uh, auditing the accounts. To be more precise, there are three parts to the accounts, namely...

110181026.text: Uh... Is it just Paimon, or is he not very good at public speaking?

110181027.text: You know what, let's leave the self-introduction there and move onto some questions.

110181029.text: Yelan forces her way through a few questions with Mingbo, then gets him to fetch Zhiyi.

110181030.text: Hello. Hehe... Not gonna lie, I'm feeling a little nervous.

110181031.text: What would you like to know? You're here to assess me, so ask away and I'll answer your questions to the best of my ability.

110181032.text: Your manifesto is very wide in its scope, but you don't seem to be personally involved in many of the specific fields. How can you be sure that you have the ability to put your plan into action?

110181034.text: Very fair question — I completely understand where you're coming from.

110181035.text: But I'm confident in my plan. I've visited many different places, talked to lots of people with far more expertise than myself, and my manifesto is the conclusion of these efforts.

110181036.text: Of course, two different problems can be interconnected in very complicated ways, and you might reach two very contradictory conclusions depending on which one you're focusing on. What I've tried to do is strike a balance. In other words, present an optimal solution to all the problems as a whole.

110181037.text: How do you plan to determine whether you are right or wrong about your proposed solution being the optimal one?

110181038.text: A great question! Well, I'd start by having my colleagues and the secretaries of the Yuehai Pavilion evaluate any proposals before implementation. Post-implementation, it would all come down to the results.

110181039.text: If it turned out that my judgment was to blame for poor results, I would take responsibility.

110181041.text: After asking Zhiyi a few questions, Yelan sends him on his way.

110181042.text: He seems like a great guy! Everything he said was thoughtful and logical and... he was just a pleasure to listen to!

subQuests.subQuestName: Report the outcome of your inspection to Uncle Tian

110180601.text: You tell Uncle Tian about the assessment process.

110180602.text: *cough* ...I see. Then it's more or less as I anticipated.

110180603.text: Alright, then let me ask this. The ideas in Zhiyi's manifesto are very similar to your own. Is there any particular reason behind this?

110180604.text: I didn't want to say anything when I gave you the list of candidates, for fear of affecting your judgment. But I can tell you now.

110180605.text: Those three candidates have all studied under me in the past. It's only natural that they share some similarities with me.

110180606.text: But Qianwei went on to focus on his business and Mingbo has always been occupied with his work at the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Of all of them, Zhiyi was with me for the longest duration.

110180607.text: Whoa! So how did you get to know them all, Uncle Tian?

110180608.text: Qianwei was referred to me by an old friend, Mingbo came to my attention in the course of my work. As for Zhiyi... Haha, that was pure happenstance.

110180609.text: We first met while fishing. Gradually, as we got to know each other, we started discussing all sorts of topics.

110180610.text: Zhiyi came from a poor family and his parents died when he was very young. But he was a gifted student and a fast learner.

110180611.text: He reminded me of a younger version of myself. So I started out giving him a few words of advice when we were out fishing, and noticed how quickly he caught on.

110180614.text: Quite. And now, all of a sudden, he's grown into a mature young man. It's a joy to see, but it also gets one thinking.

110180615.text: The young are growing up, and I am growing old. How time flies... No one can escape the cycle of life.

110180616.text: I dunno, Uncle Tian, you still seem in pretty good shape to me. You might have another few years of work left in you, don't you think?

110180617.text: Oh, you! There's really no need to console me. Having less energy than I used to isn't such a bad thing. It just means I finally have a good reason to retire and spend my days doing what old men like me should be doing: going fishing whenever I feel like it.

110180618.text: Sounds like you sure love fishing, Uncle Tian!

110180619.text: There's nothing quite like fishing to pass the time. And freshly caught fish, ah, they make the most beautiful fish soup with barely any preparation required.

110180620.text: Fresh fish soup! Mmm, sounds tasty!

110180621.text: Doesn't it? Also, some time ago, Zhiyi purchased a very special recipe from an old fisherman.

110180622.text: When we've been fishing recently, Zhiyi always brings some extra ingredients he prepared in advance. The addition of these makes the soup taste even more wonderful.

110180623.text: That flavor makes for a fond memory... But at my age, who knows how many more chances I have left to taste it again.

110180625.text: Oh, can Paimon come next time, too? Paimon really wants to try it!

110180626.text: Let's get back to the matter at hand. Uncle Tian, we've reported back, do you have a verdict?

110180627.text: Mm-hmm, I appointed you as the assessment officer, and I trust your judgment.

110180628.text: Had you not asked me why Zhiyi's ideas were so similar to mine, I was not going to mention my history with any of them.

110180629.text: This decision must be guided by what is fair and right. Please disregard all other considerations, and make your final decision only after a thorough review of each candidate's talents and capabilities.

110180633.text: Bye-bye, Uncle Tian. Look after yourself!

110180634.text: You follow Yelan outside the teahouse...

110180635.text: So... it's gonna be Zhiyi, right?

110180636.text: His manifesto was written well, and he's the best speaker...

110180637.text: Easy, let's not rush. There's no time limit for this assessment.

110180638.text: Huh? So... are you gonna give them more tests or something?

110180639.text: No, nothing like that. The assessment itself is complete. But let me give you a word of advice: Things are not always as they appear.

110180640.text: The biggest no-no in intelligence work is to only get information from the person of interest themselves. The truth is almost always hidden beneath many layers of deception. You have to get information through many different channels.

110180643.text: Lady Yelan, what are your orders?

110180644.text: Ah! Who are they? Where did they come from?

110180645.text: Did they scare you? These two are Wenyuan and Shanghua. They work for me.

110180646.text: As my trusted assistants, they are always standing guard nearby. They also perform various assignments as required.

110180647.text: Shanghua is a business expert who gets his information by trading, Wenyuan relies on word of mouth, and there is also Wupei, who's not here right now...

110180648.text: That meathead must've been out there on sea surveillance for some time now... Is he alright? I seem to remember that he can't swim.

110180649.text: Heh, nothing can take that guy down. Certainly not a little wind and waves.

110180650.text: Shanghua, visit all the commerce guilds and look into Qianwei's background. Wenyuan, go to the Ministry of Civil Affairs and look through Mingbo's work files.

110180653.text: Zhiyi? Well, obviously, as the most promising candidate, we will be investigating him ourselves.

110180654.text: Let's go to the docks first. Lots of people passing through there, you can find out all kinds of things.

110180655.text: If we're looking for information, why don't we try talking to Bolai, the owner of Wanyou Boutique?

110180656.text: He does business at the North Wharf. Maybe he'll have some news for us...

110180657.text: Hmm, that's actually not a bad idea. Let's go and ask him.

110181701.text: By the way, do you have any idea who the assessment officer is this time?

110181703.text: Me neither. They'd better get someone who knows what they're talking about, though. I don't want some amateur trying to decide my fate.

110181801.text: Do you need a hand with anything?

110181802.text: Huixin is taking some time off at the moment. I'm covering for her, just let me know if you need anything.
